lines.ruling: Ruling: finding; low (BUG-0635). Two differences, one each way. (1) The reply is wrong on the no-APTC limb: its h_no_b_issue tests only b_blank, b_changed and b_doubt, so a form with no advance payments and a filled-in column B is uniform on same_months alone. i8962 p. 14, Missing or incorrect SLCSP premium: "If either of these two situations applies to you, or if you have reason to believe the Marketplace reported the wrong applicable SLCSP premium, you must determine the correct applicable SLCSP premium for every month"; situation 1, "No APTC was paid for your coverage ... column B ... may be wrong, left blank, or reported as -0-" (also p. 16, Column (b), "or if no APTC was paid"). No APTC is a trigger of its own, not only a blank column B; the project's f1095a.no_aptc (line 33C zero) carries it. Triage pass ea49629f14d1: 2,386 of 2,842 agree; 1 completed value witness, stage18.reg.no_aptc_slcsp_by_month (no APTC, correct SLCSP $400 Jan-Jun, $300 Jul-Dec): project No, reply Yes; 398 candidate-unknown (b_doubt not stated in older class M fixtures and partials, which the project's short-circuit does not read), 57 project-unknown (line 33C withheld). (2) The project is wrong on the route where Part III differs by month: f1095a.b_wrong_asked reads only b_wrong there, so b_doubt and no advance payments never reach b_fixed_same, while b_blank does. i8962 p. 14, Line 10, "Your SLCSP premium is the same for every month ... But see Missing or incorrect SLCSP premium" and "If the correct applicable SLCSP premium is not the same for every month of 2025, check No": the line 10 test is on the corrected premium (as the project's own b_blank route reads it), and line 10 is a test (amb.2025.ptc_annual_route). A form with column A the same all year whose corrected column B is uniform gets line 10 No and lines 12-23 (a few dollars through the line 8b rounding). The reply applies the doubt test on both routes and is right there. No sample input reaches (2); not witnessed, found by reading.
